svg.title: Figure 7｜Four review stages, from boundary to reality
svg.desc: Read the four rows as review steps, not application execution. Verify each step against the actual program.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 7｜Four review stages, from boundary to reality
Identify users, external service providers and programs you own;
Stage 2: Identify major applications and data stores
Inventory actual frontends, backends, workers and necessary stores.
Do not classify every file as a container.
Give each box a name, purpose and main technology. Label who calls
whom, what data moves and the actual communication mechanism.
Match the runtime. Explicitly label unimplemented databases, APIs,
authentication and remote deployment as future plans.
Read the four rows as review steps, not application execution. Verify
each step against the actual program.
